run_minidb_to_pickle: run the minidb_to_pickle CLI to convert a Caffe2 minidb model to a pickle file
convert_model_weights: convert a Caffe2 model from minidb format to a pickled dictionary of weight blobs
unscope_blob_name: unscope a caffe2 blob name by stripping its namescope prefix
test_convert_model: test the ConvertModel function with a minidb model path and output pickle path
refactor_convert_model: refactor the ConvertModel function to support additional db types beyond minidb
